offerings.name: Search — Free Plan
offerings.pricing: $0/month; 1,000 credits / month; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped
offerings.price_basis: Free Plan（500 searches/月，每次最多10个结果）
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片结果，含标题、描述、URL；可选返回Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results，按每10个结果向上取整。

offerings.name: Search — Hobby
offerings.pricing: Hobby: $19/month billed monthly, or $16/month billed annually, for 5,000 credits per month (2,500 searches or 5,000 pages scraped). Extra 1,000 credits per $5.
offerings.price_basis: Hobby年付（月均$16，2,500 searches/月，每次最多10个结果）
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片结果，含标题、描述、URL；可选返回Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 超额包$5/1,000 credits，相当于500次最多10结果的搜索。

offerings.name: Search — Standard
offerings.pricing: $83/month, billed yearly; 100,000 credits/month; 50,000 searches. Extra 2,000 credits per $5.
offerings.price_basis: Standard年付（月均$83，50,000 searches/月，每次最多10个结果）
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片结果，含标题、描述、URL；可选返回Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 超额包$5/2,000 credits，相当于1,000次最多10结果的搜索。

offerings.name: Search — Growth
offerings.pricing: $333/month, billed yearly; 500,000 credits/month; 250,000 searches. Extra 2,500 credits per $5.
offerings.price_basis: Growth年付（月均$333，250,000 searches/月，每次最多10个结果）
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片结果，含标题、描述、URL；可选返回Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 超额包$5/2,500 credits，相当于1,250次最多10结果的搜索。

offerings.name: Search — Scale
offerings.pricing: $599/monthly, billed yearly; 1,000,000 credits/month; 500,000 searches. Extra 5,000 credits per $5.
offerings.price_basis: Scale年付（月均$599，500,000 searches/月，每次最多10个结果）
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片结果，含标题、描述、URL；可选返回Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 超额包$5/5,000 credits，相当于2,500次最多10结果的搜索。

offerings.name: End-to-End ZDR
offerings.output_type: 零数据保留的结构化搜索结果
offerings.note: 需设置enterprise:["zdr"]；Firecrawl及上游搜索提供商均不存储查询或结果。

offerings.name: Anonymized ZDR
offerings.output_type: 匿名化零数据保留的结构化搜索结果
offerings.note: 需设置enterprise:["anon"]；Firecrawl不保留数据，上游可能缓存匿名查询。
